fact: NISR published the Rwanda Vital Statistics Report 2025 on 16 April 2026, covering January to December 2025 and compiled from the civil registration system (356,838 births and 39,355 deaths registered in 2025).

NISR released the Rwanda Vital Statistics Report 2025 on 16 April 2026; figures cover 2025: 356,838 births and 39,355 deaths registered, birth registration completeness 92.9% and death registration completeness 50.5%.

MINEDUC published the 2024/2025 Education Statistical Yearbook in February 2026, covering the school year July 2024 to June 2025 (institutions, enrolment, staff, infrastructure, learning outcomes), compiled from the annual school census.

NISR published the Rwanda Vital Statistics Report 2024 in April 2025 (figures cover vital events of 2024), generated from the NCI-CRVS civil registration system, with NIDA and the Rwanda Biomedical Centre helping to draft it.
The report calls itself Rwanda's sixth vital statistics report and the annual vital statistics report, a reference for future publications in the same scope; published April 2025 (covers 2024).

MINEDUC published the 2023/2024 Education Statistical Yearbook in March 2025 (figures cover the school year to July 2024), drawn mainly from the School Data Management System plus district, higher-education institution, Rwanda Correctional Services, Rwanda TVET Board and National Child Development Agency returns.

The Ministry of Health published the Annual Health Statistical Booklet for FY 2023-2024 on 10 October 2025 (figures cover FY 2023/24), derived from the Rwanda Health Management Information System (facility registers, EMRs, community health worker data) and the CRVS system including verbal autopsies.
